description: §23.2.4a E-FOREIGN-007 — an unbuildable slice (`args.length +;`) one block deep, inside an `if` in a `kind="tool"` main. The refusal must reach the compile result as an Error wherever the slice sits. Before s456 the diagnostic travelled on a channel the `if` body's emit options did not carry: the compile exited 0 and the artifact held `const plan = null /* E-FOREIGN-007 … */`, which crashed at run time (adopter flogence, graph-ingest-tool.scrml).
rationale: §23.2.4a: a slice that is not valid JavaScript as the body of a strict-mode async function of its crossings SHALL be a compile error (E-FOREIGN-007). §2.2.1: a codegen path that cannot lower a construct SHALL emit a hard diagnostic rather than a silent stub, and a compile reporting an Error SHALL NOT produce a runnable artifact. Neither depends on the block nesting of the slice.
